product_one_liner.value: Appspace is a workplace-experience platform for organizations that brings employee communications and workplace tools—including intranet, mobile app, digital signage, room booking, and visitor management—together.
product_one_liner.notes: The platform overview names intranet, employee mobile app, digital signage, room booking, visitor management, and related tools; the pricing page describes the platform as serving workplace communications and office spaces.

pricing_page.notes: The cited Appspace page is a public pricing page and describes how pricing works.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The case-studies page displays Costco Wholesale, and the Insight case study states that Insight chose Appspace. | named_customers.0: The case-studies page displays Costco Wholesale as a customer. | named_customers.1: The case study identifies Insight as an Appspace customer.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company report states that Appspace is headquartered in Tampa, Florida. | hq_country: The company report and LinkedIn company profile place Appspace headquarters in Tampa, Florida, United States.

founded_year.notes: The company background excerpt states Appspace was founded in 2002.

eng_blog.notes: The visible blog-index evidence shows workplace-communication content and a headless-CMS explainer, not at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built. This supports false under the stated criterion.

public_docs.notes: The public Appspace Knowledge Center contains multiple product and setup articles, including supported devices, device properties, and configuring the Appspace app on BrightSign.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers listing shows seven openings and names the roles; none of the titles is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.value: Appspace does not name its default model or provider; its public BYOM information lists Microsoft Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry (also called Microsoft Foundry), and Google Gemini as connectable options.
model_provider.notes: The AI FAQ says Appspace has its own default model but does not name it, while the BYOM announcement names Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Google Gemini as models/providers customers can connect. The answer distinguishes these options from an unnamed default.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Appspace security page names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR in its security and compliance listing. | compliance_certs.0: The cited security listing names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The same listing names ISO 27001. | compliance_certs.2: The same listing names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile labels the September 2023 latest round as Series A; the investor announcement describes it as a strategic growth investment. | funding_date: The funding record dates the latest round to September 21, 2023, which corresponds to 2023-09. | funding_amount_usd: The funding record has no reported USD amount, and the investor announcement describes a significant investment without stating a numeric amount. A separate database display is not clearly labeled as USD, so no USD amount can be asserted.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round was in September 2023, before the 18-month period preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers listing includes a Business Development Representative position and Enterprise Account Executive positions.

launched_6mo.notes: The July 10, 2026 Dorado announcement describes new AI-powered conversational analytics across Appspace products, within the six months before the run date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Appspace announced on March 19, 2026 that Eric Daggett was appointed Chief Sales Officer and Dan Ward joined as Chief Technology Officer, within the 12 months before the run date.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Appspace business-development job posting names Salesforce, SalesLoft, and Chili Piper as software platforms used by the team. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting names Salesforce as one of the sales platforms used. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job posting names SalesLoft as one of the sales platforms used. | crm_stack_signal.2: The job posting names Chili Piper as one of the sales platforms used.
